function.name: tavily_search
function.description: Search the web. Returns results with title, url and content.

search_depth.description: advanced: highest relevance, more latency, 2 credits. basic: balanced, 1 credit. fast: lower latency with good relevance, 1 credit. ultra-fast: lowest latency, 1 credit, returns one NLP summary per URL instead of chunks.

chunks_per_source.description: Maximum relevant chunks (short snippets) returned per source; controls the length of content. Available when search_depth is advanced, basic or fast.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

topic.description: news is useful for real-time updates about politics, sports and major current events from mainstream media. general is for broader searches across a wide range of sources. finance is available on some plans only.

time_range.description: Time window back from today, matched against publish or last-updated date. By default, results with no detectable published date are kept; set filter_by_published_date to true to remove them.

start_date.description: Return results after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), by publish or last-updated date. By default, results with no detectable published date are kept; set filter_by_published_date to true to remove them.

end_date.description: Return results before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), by publish or last-updated date. By default, results with no detectable published date are kept; set filter_by_published_date to true to remove them.

include_published_date.description: Beta. Adds a published_date field to each result (Tavily's best estimate; null when undetectable). Turned on automatically when topic is news.

filter_by_published_date.description: Removes results outside the time_range / start_date / end_date window, and also removes results with no detectable date. Also turns on include_published_date.

include_domains.description: Domains to include, maximum 300. Wildcards such as .com are shown in the best-practices examples. A hard filter unless include_domains_mode is prefer, so listing a few retailers excludes every other site.

include_domains_mode.description: restrict limits results to include_domains. prefer also searches the rest of the web, so other sites can still appear.

country.description: Boosts results from one country (a boost, not a filter). Available only when topic is general. Country-level only: there is no city or region targeting, so put a city in the query text.

language.description: Boosts results in a language. Accepts an ISO 639-1 code (en, fr, zh-cn) or an English name (english). Write the query in the same language.

filter_by_language.description: Strictly filters out results that do not match language instead of only boosting them, so it can return few or no results. Requires language.

include_raw_content.description: Full cleaned page content per result. true or markdown gives markdown; text gives plain text and may add latency. For deep extraction the best-practices page suggests Search first, then the Extract API.

include_answer.description: LLM-written answer to the query. true or basic is quick; advanced is more detailed. Only useful if you do not bring your own model.

exact_match.description: Only returns results containing the exact quoted phrase(s) in the query, bypassing synonyms. Wrap the phrase in quotes inside query.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum age of Tavily's cached copy of each result. Unset: cached copies, fetched live as needed. 1 to 720: only cached copies fetched within that many hours. 0: always fetch live. -1: never fetch live. Lower values cost no extra credits but live fetching adds latency, and results that are too old and cannot be fetched live are left out, so you can get fewer than max_results.
